findings.claim: Step 3's four (t2) acceptance criteria have no executed proof at the candidate: the merge-path gate runs only tests/meta/ and tests/unit/, tests_full_portfolio is in no profile, and the plan's AC3 substitutes a grep for four function names in tests/integration/test_llm_budget_fallback.py for actually running them.
findings.fix: Either run tests/integration/test_llm_budget_fallback.py at the candidate and record its result as the proof of the four criteria, or re-tier the file to the merge path; a grep for def names is not an executed proof of behaviour.

findings.claim: Step 6's three (t2) criteria (server lifted, timeout lifted, deferred batch NOT lifted) are recorded verified by AC5, which only greps REOCR_INFRA_ERROR_KINDS in wan/api/admin.py; tests/integration/test_admin_reocr_failed.py — the only test that asserts what the sweep actually lifts — was never selected by any gate at the candidate.
findings.fix: Run tests/integration/test_admin_reocr_failed.py at the candidate (or move it to the merge path) and cite its result; the negative criterion (deferred batch NOT lifted) in particular cannot be proven by a constant grep.

findings.claim: Step 8's three (t2) criteria — and with them the plan success criterion that an app/gateway mismatch is caught before production — rest solely on tests/integration/test_model_map_drift.py, which needs a live gateway, was never executed at the candidate, and which the repository's own backlog records as currently RED in the nightly tier (IMP-631).
findings.fix: Close IMP-631 (or scope the check) so the drift test is green, then execute it at the candidate and cite the run; a criterion whose only proof is a test known to be failing is not verified.

findings.claim: The manual criteria of Steps 2 and 7 (GET /model/info returns both WAN cheap aliases after restart; a cheap-alias call returns a non-empty answer) are contradicted at the same commit by IMP-633, which records that svc-litellm was never recreated, so neither num_retries: 0 nor reasoning_effort is live in the gateway — the criteria depend on a deployment the range does not contain.
findings.fix: Do not mark Steps 2 and 7 verified until svc-litellm is force-recreated and both checks are recorded with date and output; until then mark them explicitly as pending deployment, since the backlog also forbids deploying wan-api without _REASONING_EFFORT_OVERRIDE before that.

findings.claim: Three of the six plan-level acceptance criteria (AC1, AC2, AC6) are proven by patterns that read files outside the reviewed range — /opt/eco/docs/... and /opt/eco/services/litellm/litellm_config.yaml — so plan_diff: pass cannot be reproduced from the candidate and says nothing about what the range contains.
findings.fix: Record, next to each out-of-repo AC, the commit or hash of the file in the docs/services repository that satisfied it, so the proof is pinned to a state someone can re-check later instead of to whatever those shared files happened to contain at gate time.
